data.headline: NVIDIA’s data-center sales reach $107.6 billion
data.summary: NVIDIA reported data-center revenue of $107.6 billion for the quarter ended October 25, up 110% from a year earlier. Leveraged funds widened their E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures net long in the earlier November 10 report.

bull.text: Leveraged funds’ November 10 net long increased to 13,967 contracts from 10,073 on November 3.

bear.text: The asset-manager net long slipped to 72,785 contracts. The ten-year Treasury benchmark was 5.12% on November 16.

watch.text: NVIDIA projected $130 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, plus or minus 3%, with an extra week in the quarter and zero China data-center compute revenue assumed.

limitations: The positioning figures describe Nasdaq-100 futures. The issuer outlook is forward-looking.
The evidence packet lacks matched analyst expectations, a post-release QQQ return and a full option chain.
